high_risk_moment: Drafting technical financial and interest rate explanations for public readers
stakeholder: Online financial readers and retail consumers
harm_description: Readers receive ungrounded false mathematical formulas on savings yields leading to suboptimal financial decisions
existing_controls: Basic post-generation spellcheck and optional manual read-through by copy editor
proposed_controls: Automated factual grounding verification against verified knowledge base and mandatory domain expert sign-off
human_oversight: Domain specialist editor must review and verify all numerical claims before export
monitoring_metric: Post-publication factual correction rate per 100 generated articles
trigger_threshold: More than 0 unverified numerical claims detected in published sample audits
response_action: Temporarily suspend auto-drafting for numerical topics and initiate prompt grounding audit

high_risk_moment: Synthesizing creative marketing copy and long-form articles from broad web prompts
stakeholder: Original journalistic authors and intellectual property copyright holders
harm_description: Model regurgitates substantial verbatim extracts of copyrighted proprietary investigations without licensing or attribution
existing_controls: Standard terms of service prohibiting intentional copyright infringement by users
proposed_controls: Real-time n-gram and embedding similarity checks against indexed web sources with automatic source attribution
human_oversight: Legal and compliance officer reviews any draft with over 15 percent lexical similarity to external sources
monitoring_metric: Percentage of generated drafts triggering copyright similarity flags above threshold
trigger_threshold: Copyright similarity match score exceeding 15 percent on non-public domain text
response_action: Block export until author rewrites content or adds verified licensing attribution
